title: Kimberling's inequality for Archimedean copulas: proof and Lean 4 formalization
description: Proof, with a machine-checked Lean 4 formalization, that every bivariate Archimedean copula C with completely monotone inverse generator satisfies C(a,a) - a^2 >= C(u,v) - uv with a = (u+v)/2, answering MathOverflow question 195959 (C. Kimberling, 2015). The accompanying note also proves on paper (not formalized) a stronger result for strict Archimedean copulas that are stochastically increasing: C - uv is Schur-concave. It gives counterexamples showing that LTD/TP2 Archimedean copulas, and symmetric SI or density-TP2 non-Archimedean copulas, can violate the inequality. The Lean statement is identical to the Left to Solve statement mo-195959. Bernstein's theorem is taken from the TauCeti library (Apache-2.0). We found no earlier proof in the sources examined (see NOTE.md for the search and its limitations). The work was developed with AI assistance; the author is responsible for the content.
